appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' and has tick marks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, and 3000.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line graph plots the number of new tourists over time, starting at 1000 in 1880.
The line rises to a peak of approximately 3,100 tourists in 1890.
The line then falls to approximately 2,600 tourists in 1891.
The line shows a general upward trend from 1880 to 1890, followed by a downward trend from 1890 to 1891.
The line is not perfectly linear; it has several distinct peaks and troughs, including a dip around 1887.

public_definitions: The task is to review the Town Z new-tourist trend dashboard for 1880-1891.
The user must choose one of three options for the follow-up route for the tourism operations trend.
The three options are: 'Route to tourism growth planning', 'Route to tourism decline response', and 'Keep on routine tourism monitoring'.
uncertain: The exact numerical values for each year are not labeled on the chart, only approximate positions are visible.
The chart title suggests a 'decreasing' trend, but the visual data shows an increase from 1880 to 1890, followed by a decrease in 1891.
